//: MCP Configuration for Claude - HTTP/SSE Transport
Use this when the MCP server runs with HTTP transport (e.g. Docker, remote).
The server exposes: GET /sse (SSE stream), POST /message?sessionId=... (client messages)
claude mcp add --transport http crypto http://localhost:3001/sse
OPTION 2 - Claude Desktop config (if it supports HTTP):
Add to mcpServers with url instead of command:

crypto.//: Or use transport http with full URL to your deployed MCP server
